gpt-5.6-luna · strict json_schema
5-page windows · 32 parallel workers
units · specs · parts · verbatim quotes
47% of 70.4M input tokens
served from the prompt cache

for every printed heading

span.p:
ground.py — every quote is searched
for in the PDF text layer.
Not found = DROPPED.
A marker can only sit on ink
the manufacturer printed.

chain is baggy

A hallucinated section
never reaches the screen.

sections · at most 6 pages
dealer boilerplate stripped
one bear-2 compression call, -31%

chat.answer
gpt-5.6-terra · RESPONSES API STREAMING
prompt_cache_key pinned per route+model
the model may only emit [p. N]
43% cached · first token p50 2.6 s

div.style: color: rgb(5, 62, 44) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
the MODEL names a page,
the SERVER slices the quote out of
the ORIGINAL page text.
Verbatim by construction —
100% of 43 citations.

span.p:
every digit in the answer must be
printed on a page it was given
(step numbers and [p. N] excluded)
0 invented numbers in 25 answers

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AN ANSWER WHERE EVERY SENTENCE
CARRIES A [p. N] CHIP
that jumps to that page

search_context_size low · max_tool_calls 2
one pipe-delimited line per offer

own text never reaches the UI;
every URL is HEAD-fetched in parallel,
404/410/5xx dropped; FX done in Python

CHEAPEST FIRST
~7 cents cold, free cached

span.p: BUILD TIME

gpt-image-1
97 part illustrations + the shipped logo
one style prompt, one camera, one scale
1024px transparent · $0.042 each

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
images.score · VISION AS A JUDGE
gpt-5.6-luna · strict json_schema rubric
single bike · whole bike · sharpness ·
view angle · is it really the model
4,136 calls · $2.04

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
VOICE — the agent thinks with an OpenAI model through Deepgram,
and may ONLY call our grounded tools: find_procedure · read_page · get_spec · list_parts.
Deepgram calls this API directly, so the manual text never passes through the browser. First audio 0.7-2.0 s.

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HONEST ABOUT WHAT WE DO NOT USE: no fine-tuning · no Batch API · no Assistants API ·
no embeddings and no vector store in the live path. Retrieval is BM25 over a book we already structured.

svg.text: Mechanica — every OpenAI call, and the guardrail that catches it
